integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained apart from a standard trihedral solid-angle identity; direct convex-hull Monte Carlo and angular-formula checks are corroborative, not a substitute for proof. The regular-octahedron probability and the generic expected-shadow-angle formula are acknowledged prior knowledge. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified height family of right triangular antiprisms with equilateral radius-one bases, Haar-uniform orthogonal planar projections and positive height; general affine octahedra and different random viewing laws remain outside scope. Priority is provisional.
title: A sharp opposite-extremum law for random triangular-antiprism silhouettes
